data.name: Joe Danger 2: The Movie
data.detailed_description:
Joe Danger, the world’s most determined stuntman, returns to embark on a death-defying thrill-ride across the set of the greatest blockbuster movie ever made. Across 100 crazy levels he’ll chase crooks by police bike, destroy laser-firing robots with a stolen jetpack, escape giant boulders in a minecart, time-travel to punch dinosaurs from a quad bike and divert nuclear missiles on a unicycle. Strap on the helmet of Joe Danger, impress the director and make action movie history!
  • Create insane new levels in the Movie Maker and share or download new ones through Steam Workshop!
  • Play on your TV through Steam Big Picture, or at your desk with new mouse and keyboard controls!
  • Experience Joe Danger like never before with specially enhanced graphics for PC!
  • Build and share Minecraft levels and race as one of the nine characters from Team Fortress 2!
  • Race against other players with seamlessly downloaded ghosts, and rise up the ranks on the leaderboards!
  • Beat your friends in fun four-player local multiplayer!

reviews.review:
Fuck this game. Genuinely a terrible sequel to an unironically great addition to the motocross genre. Want to see a list of what they changed? 

They made the physics suck ass except for the mini bikes from the first game/the banana mode. The skis suck to play, the jetpack is an ACTUAL snoozefest, the quad is lame, and for the most part even when riding bikes its the new ones added to this game which have infinitely worse physics from the first game. OH MY GOD. I forgot about the minecart so I'm writing this in far after the fact it's that forgetable, it also sucks to play.

They  made the "Pro" medals easy as shit, gee thanks a lot, making the games EVEN EASIER. I'm not gonna pretend the first game wasn't an easy 100%, because it was, but that just makes it so much worse that they made this one easier. The one exception was the final level to the undead pack, that level was actualy fun, because it brought back the old bike, it had like, every star, and it was a pro medal, and the level had good challenge to it.

The theming is so uninspired. at first its like, pretty cool, right? Oh, we have the famous stunt driver from the first game partnering up with a director to make crazy stunt heavy movies! And then the levels do not reflect this at all except for the vauge illusion of it being a scene from a film. wow. This is one of the main issues with having level themes instead of handcrafted levels like in a series like trials. Because believe it or not, not every movie is the same with the same excact scenes rinse-and-repeat for 7 hours. 

Speaking of rinse and repeating, what about the levels themselves. Fuck you because they literally repeat the same obstacle over. and over.  and why the hell not over again. NO I'M NOT TALKING ABOUT THE OBJECTS THAT GET IN YOUR WAY. I'm talking about entire sections of the level, copy and pasted, throughout the entire game. So there's is maybe what, 10 unique levels? probably less if I'm being honest. The only standout was the undead movie pack yet again. 

In fact, let's talk about the Undead movie pack. It stands as a shining hope of what could've been for a multitude of reasons. First of all, it ditches any vehicle except OG bike. thank god. And you may be thinking, "clearly you just like the bike and you don't like anything new" you don't understand. YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND how much worse every new vehicle is compared to the old game physics. anyways, the movie pack also has handcrafted levels, not rinse and repeat sections. But also, it ditches the new movie stuff (disable nukes, fight this guy, ect.) and just reskins stuff from Joe Danger, except for the fire skull thing, which is honestly pretty fun. I like the undead movie pack.

Back to the bull part of the game now. They completely mutilated the gameplay loop. I checked back on joe danger 1 before writing this just cause oh, maybe I'm judging this game to harshly and the first wasn't that great and I need to take off my rose tinted glasses. No. I was right. In the first game, there is an emphasis on dodging and doing cool stunts, and getting all the stars. in joe danger 2 there is also an emphasis on dodging and... doing the singular task in the level. seriously there's usually like, four stars max for each level, making it a slog, and the timer star is nonexistent practically. and they add pro medals. without the time-limiting star. you know what that leads to? slow and cautious gameplay on a pro medal, cause doesn't it just yell "PRO" when the person is going super slow to safely get every star without any time risk?  okay, what about the dodging? surely they couldn't have fucked that up since the control scheme and abilities are the same an- oh what that? they messed with the camera so you can't see shit in front of you? they made it about reaction time? and the level themes, backgrounds, and decoration is so noisy that you sometimes LITERALLY CANNOT SEE OBSTACLES on top of not being able to see in front of you!? Of fucking course they did! And I'm not exagerating about the noisyness of the vissuals, it is actually horendus how crowded everything is so you don't even notice the solitary bear trap blending in with the road as team nasty drives by spiting dust in front of thew whole screen with cars flying by. Also, every new obstacle sucks. There's this one where it's on a short timer, right, and when it is up, it switches from a duck to dodge obstacle to a jump to dodge and vise versa. Cool, Right?, until you catch it on a bad cycle where you are perfectly lined up for it to switch right as you pass. Great. There's this one level in particular that spams them. Need I say more.

Okay, but finally, let's talk about the game in the context of real life. This game was a rushed money grab. It was released in the same year as the first game, and it shows. 4 of the achievments are broken, and you have to use SAM, the theme is, as discussed, uninspired, the physics of all the new things likley suck because it was rushed. and they knew it, and so that's why they avoided new things in the undead movie pack because they knew what they had before was better. But also, you can tell this was a cash grab because they have TF2 characters. what are we doing. And Minecraft steve. they have minecraft steve in this game, what are we doing. To me, what this game looks like it a contractor/publisher being the dumbass and forcing a small studio to excreet a game as fast as humanly possible, and that is sad. It really says a lot that I find the best thing I got out of this game to be my steam profile background. Unironically I only kept playing this game to pass the time limit so I could get it. Check it out, it's really funny.

Anyways, thats my deranged ramblings of a cup of tea.
